auth.signInInstead: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.wishlistIntro: Tutor is invite-only for now. Create an account to join the wishlist and we'll let you know when you're in.

profile.setupIntro: A profile is one language you're learning, with its own progress. You can add more later.
profile.name: Name
profile.goalPlaceholder: e.g. read Le Petit Prince in French

progress.empty: Nothing tracked yet. Lessons will add words and grammar here as you practise.

lab.title: Voice lab
lab.intro: Compare speech models on your own voice before we pick them for lessons. Nothing here affects your progress.
lab.recordHint: Record yourself saying the sentence. Also try saying it wrong on purpose: a good model writes what you actually said, not what you meant.
lab.diffLegend: Highlighted words differ from the sentence above (case and punctuation ignored, accents count).

lesson.typedCheckIntro: Some of this can't be heard, only seen in writing. Type the sentence to check the spelling.
lesson.contest: I think my answer was right

flashcards.title: Flashcards
flashcards.description: Pick or type the right word. Quick, no AI.

say.title: Say the word
say.description: Say words and short phrases out loud.

sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.description: Translate and speak full sentences, graded by AI.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: A short text with tap-to-translate words and quick questions.

passiveCards.title: Passive flashcards
passiveCards.description: A slow slideshow of all the cards to keep on in the background and glance at. Doesn't count toward progress.

passiveStudy.title: Passive learning
passiveStudy.description: Each word and grammar point with its forms and examples, shown long enough to read, in a loop. Doesn't count toward progress.

cards.empty: No cards in this lesson yet.

passive.noProgress: Passive viewing doesn't change your progress.
passive.noDetails: None of these items have details yet, so only the words are shown. Open an item or the lesson to ask the coach to fill them in.

study.writing: The coach is writing study notes and item details…
study.missingGuide: This lesson has no study notes yet.
study.failed: Some of it couldn't be written. You can try again.
study.fill: Ask the coach to fill in

lessonStatus.building: The coach is building this lesson…

coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: Describe what you want to learn, or ask for a plan. The coach proposes lessons; you decide what gets added.
coach.suggestPlan: Propose a plan for my goal
coach.suggestCafe: A lesson for ordering at a café

reading.intro: A short text written for this lesson, with questions. It's written once and kept until you ask for a new one.
reading.tapHint: Tap any underlined word to see what it means.

wishlist.pendingBody: Thanks for your interest in Tutor! We're letting people in gradually and will let you know as soon as your account is approved.
wishlist.title: Wishlist
wishlist.intro: People who signed up and are waiting to be let in. Only approved users and admins can use the app.
